name: The Halberd and the Tiger
source: A wandering spirit guardian and her tiger companion seek to protect the world they live in. When a quest goes astray, Li must face both herself and her beliefs with heart and halberd in hand.
translation: A wandering spirit guardian and her tiger companion seek to protect the world they live in. When a quest goes astray, Li must face both herself and her beliefs with heart and halberd in hand.
